prompt: Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Use Ink and Electric Yellow: page #181818, text #FAFAFA, accent #F4E84A, secondary surface #303030, text on accent #111111. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
